newsitem.title: USA: Amoco restores natgas output in U.S. Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Amoco restores natgas output in U.S. Gulf.

text.p: Amoco Corp said Tuesday it had restored all its U.S. Gulf of Mexico (USG) natural gas output that was automatically shut-in as a precaution ahead of Tropical Storm Josephine.
"We're back today," said John Curry, public affairs advisor for Amoco, noting the restorations had moved in a west-to-east direction roughly echoing the storm's movement.

Amoco, which had restored 90 percent of output by Monday, has daily output of 609 million cubic feet a day (mmcfd), compared to gross production in its areas of 1.37 billion cfd. The storm shut about 60 percent of gross output, Curry said.
The company's USG crude output, meanwhile, was not interrupted by the storm.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
